title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Disputes of Return Charges
content:
A Ridgeline Tool Rental renter may dispute a damage repair, deductible, cleaning, fuel or missing accessory charge by a damage dispute request naming the charge.

**Filing window.** The dispute must be filed no later than the class's damage dispute window, in calendar days, after the equipment was returned. Days are counted as calendar days from the date part of the return time as day 0 to the date the dispute is filed; filing on the last day qualifies. The return time is the one on the agreement record and the filing date is the date the dispute request was registered.

## Window check (hypothetical return on 3 March at 18:40)

| Class window | Filed on | Day count | Within the window |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7 days | 3 March | 0 | yes |
| 7 days | 10 March | 7 | yes (last day) |
| 7 days | 11 March | 8 | no |
| 14 days | 17 March | 14 | yes (last day) |
| 14 days | 18 March | 15 | no |

The time of day of the return does not move the count; only its date is day 0.

## Former clause

> Former clause: an adjustment posted only when the damage dispute request had status approved, for the amount approved and never more than the disputed charge, and a charge already adjusted could not be adjusted again. This clause is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for adjusting a disputed damage repair charge on a protected agreement.

## Charges that may be disputed

| Charge on the agreement | Disputable by a damage dispute |
|---|---|
| damage repair | yes |
| damage deductible | yes |
| cleaning fee | yes |
| refuelling charge | yes |
| missing accessory charge | yes |

superseded_clauses: An adjustment posts only when the damage dispute request has status approved, for the amount approved and never more than the disputed charge; a charge already adjusted cannot be adjusted again.
